title: Check File Permissions
description: Inspect permissions and ownership of a specified file.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

FILE="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "$FILE" || ! -e "$FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 /path/to/file" >&2
    exit 1
fi

stat -c 'Path: %n
Permissions: %A (%a)
Owner: %U
Group: %G' "$FILE"
